title: Bridging Modalities: Enhancing Cross-Modality Hate Speech Detection with Few-Shot In-Context Learning
reasoning: The paper explores using Large Language Models (LLMs) to detect hate speech across different modalities (text and vision-language memes). While the hate speech datasets used include categories targeting religious groups (e.g., Islam and Judaism), the study is focused on the technical transferability of detection capabilities rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems.
